Here’s a quick rundown of some key players who have worn the Los Angeles Clippers jersey—both from recent seasons and from the franchise’s history:

| Era | Notable Players |
|-----|-----------------|
| **Present (2025‑26)** | *Paul George*, *Julius Randle*, *Kawhi Leonard* (joined 2023), *Reggie Jackson*, *Chris Paul* (2020‑21), *Jalen Green*, *Bam Adebayo* (traded 2024), *Marcus Morris*, *Darius Miles*, *Gordon Hayward* (2024‑25) |
| **2010s** | *Chris Paul* (2007‑12), *Blake Griffin* (2009‑15), *DeAndre Jordan* (2008‑18), *Jamal Crawford* (2009‑10), *Julius Randle* (2015‑19), *Kendrick Perkins* (2014‑17), *Jae Crowder* (2014‑16) |
| **2000s** | *P.J. Brown* (1999‑04), *Randy Foye* (2000‑02), *Julius Hodge* (2000‑01), *Moses Malone* (1979‑80, early 1980s), *Gary Payton* (1998‑99) |
| **1990s** | *Michael Olowokandi* (1996‑98), *Terry Porter* (1994‑95), *Steve Kerr* (1993‑94), *Mark Jackson* (1992‑93) |
| **1980s & earlier** | *Moses Malone* (1979‑80, 1981‑82), *Gary Payton* (early 1990s), *John Lucas* (1979‑80), *Bob McAdoo* (1979‑80) |

> **Quick note:** The Clippers’ roster changes each offseason, so the “present” list reflects the lineup around the 2025‑26 season. For the most up‑to‑date roster, check the official LA Clippers website or a reputable sports news source.
